paite: Huan Paikan Ankuangluina ding ni guk a-om lai a, Jesu'n misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh Lazaras omna khua, Bethani ahong tung hi.
heading: Bethani A Jesu Thaunilhna / (Mat 26.6-13; Mar 14.3-9)
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

paite: Huai ah amah a ding in nitak an abawl ua, Martha in nek abawl hi, Lazaras bel a-ankuang umpih khat ahi.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

paite: Mari in spiknardi buk kimkhat thaunamtui manphatak ahon tawi a, Jesu khete anuh a, asam in anul a, huai thaugim in insung adimta hi.
english: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

paite: Himahleh Judas Iskariot, anungzuite lak a khat, amansak ding pa'n,
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

paite: "Hiai thaunamtui bangziak a makhai zathum a zuak a migentheite kiang a pe zaw lou uh ahia?" achi hi.
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

paite: Migentheite a-awlmoh ziak a hiai thu gen ahi kei; amah guta ahi a, dangka ip akem a, asung a koih a alak zel ziak ahi zaw hi.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

paite: Jesu'n, "Subuai kei un, ka kivui ni a dia asit ahi.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

paite: Na kiang ua migentheite om gige ahi ua, kei bel na kiang ua om gige ding ka hi kei,” achi hi.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

paite: Huan huai mun ah Jesu a-om chih Juda mipite'n atheih un; ahong ua, Jesu ziak kia hilou in, misi lak a kipan a akaihthoh, Lazaras mah leng amuh nop ziak uh ahi.
heading: Lazaras Thah Sawmna
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

paite: Huan siampu liante Lazaras leng thah ding in akihou uhi.
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

paite: Amah ziak a Judate tampi in langkaisan a, Jesu agintak ziak un.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

paite: Azing in, Ankuangluina a hong mipi tampi'n Jerusalem ah Jesu ahong pai ding chih azak un,
heading: Jesu Vualzou A Jerusalem Lutna / (Mat 21.1-11; Mar 11.1-11; Luk 19.28-40)
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

paite: tumnahte atawi ua, dawn ding in apawtkhia ua, "Hosanna! Toupa min a Israelte Kumpipa hong pai ahampha e!" chi in akikou uhi.
english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

paite: Huan Jesu'n sabiltungnou amu a, atung ah atuang hi.
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

paite: "Lau ke'n, Zion tanu; en in, na Kumpipa, sabiltungnou tung a tuang in, ahong pai ding," chih gelh ahih bang in.
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

paite: Huai thute atung in anungzuite'n atheisiam kei ua; himahleh, Jesu pahtawi ahih nung in, atanchin ah huai thu gelh ahi chih leh amah tung ah huai thilte akihih ngei chih atheita uhi.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

paite: Huan han a kipan asapkhiakpa Lazaras, misi lak a kipan akaihthoh lai a akiang a mipi omte'n, athu atheihpih uhi.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

paite: Huaiziak in ahi, mipite'n leng amah ava dawn uh; huai thillamdang ahih chih atheih ziak un.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

paite: Huchi in Pharisaite'n, "Thei un, bangmah na hihtheih louh uh, en un, khovel in amah azuita,” akichi uhi.
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

paite: Huan ankuangluina a Pathian be ding a hohtoute lak ah Grik kuate hiam a-om uhi.
heading: Grikte Ngetna
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

paite: Huaite Galili gam a Bethsaida a mi Philip kiang ah ahong ua, akiang ah, "Pu, Jesu ka mu nuam uh," achi ua, angen uhi.
english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

paite: Philip in Andru ahong hilh a, Andru leh Philip in Jesu ahong hilh uhi.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang uah, "Mihing Tapa pahtawi a a-omna ding hun atungta hi.
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

paite: Chihtaktak in, chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, lei a buhtang akiak a, asih phot keileh amah kia in a-om tawntung; asih in bel, tampi in agah hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

paite: Kuapeuh ahinna it in amangsak ding a; kuapeuh hiai khovel a ahinna ngaineu in tangtawn hinna ah akem ding hi.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

paite: Kuapeuh in ka nna asepleh hon zui hen; ka omna ah ka sikha leng a-om ding hi; kuapeuh in kanna asepleh Pa'n amah apahtawi ding hi.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

paite: "Tu in ka kha amangbang mahmah; bang ka genta dia? 'Pa, hiai hun a pan hon hondam in, ka chi dia hia?' Himahleh hiai ding ziak mah a hiai hun a hong pai lah ka ngal a.
heading: Jesu Sih Ding Genkholhna
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

paite: Pa na min pahtawi in," achi hi. Huchi in van a kipan in aw ahong suak a, "Ka pahtawita, ka pahtawi nawn lai ding,” achi hi.
english: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

paite: Mipi akiang a dinghte'n huai aza ua, "Vanpiging ahi," achi ua; midangte'n, "Angel in amah houpih ahi," achi uhi.
english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, "Huai aw kei a dia hong suak ahi kei, noumau a ding ahi zaw," achi hi.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

paite: "Tu hiai khovel thukhensakna hun ahi; tu hiai khovel lal paihkhiak hun ahi.
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

paite: Huan lei a kipan a khaikang a ka omleh, mi tengteng keimah kiang ah ka hip ding," achi hi.
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

paite: Huai thu asihdan ding theihsakna dia agen ahi.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

paite: Huan mipi'n akiang ah, "Khrist tangtawn in a-om chih Dan Bu ah ka thei uh, nang Mihing Tapa khaikang a om ding ka hi, bangchi chih a chi na hia? Huai Mihing Tapa kua ahia?" achi ua, adong uhi.
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na lak uah sawt lou sung vak a-om tadih hi. Huai vak na neih sung un vak ah khosa un, huchi lou in zaw mial in ahon lap ding hi. Kuapeuh mial a khosa in apaina athei kei hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

paite: Vak na neih sung un vak gingta un, vak tate na hong hihtheihna ding un," achi hi. Huai thute Jesu'n agen a; huan apai a, amuh louh ding un akiselta hi.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

paite: Ama uah huchi tel a tam thillamdang hih mahleh, amah agingta tuan kei uh.
heading: Judate Leh Ginglou Mipite
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

paite: "Toupa, ka thugen uh kua'n ahia gingta? Toupa khut leng kua kiang ah ahia latsak a a-om?" chi a zawlnei Isai thugen atangtunna ding in.
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

paite: Hiai ziak in ahi a gintak theih louh uh, Isai in,
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

paite: "Ama'n amit uh ahihtaw a, alungtang uh ahihkhauh; huchi lou in zaw amit un amu kha ding ua, alungtang un athei kha ding uh, huan hong kihei nawn ding ua, ke'n amau ka hihdam kha ding," chih agen nawn ziak in.
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

paite: Hiai thilte Isai in athupina amuh a atanchin agen ahi.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

paite: Himahleh, heutute lak nangawn ah tampi in Jesu agingta uhi; himahleh Pharisaite ziak in akipulak nuam kei uh, huchi lou in zaw sinagog a kipan ahawlkhe kha ding uhi;
english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

paite: Pathian pahtakna sang a mihing pahtakna adeih zawk ziak un.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

paite: Huan Jesu akikou a, "Kuapeuh hon gingta, kei hon gingta ahi kei a, hon sawlpa gingta ahi zaw hi.
heading: Jesu'n Vantang A Thuhilhna
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon mu hon sawlpa mu ahi.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

paite: Khovel a vak hong pai pen ka hi, kuapeuh kei hon gingta mial a a-omlouhna ding in.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

paite: Kuapeuh ka thugen za in, gingta kei mahleh, ke'n siam louh ka tangsak kei; khovel siam louh tangsak ding a hong pai ka hi kei a, khovel humbit ding a hong pai ka hi zaw hi.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

paite: Kuapeuh kei hon deih lou a, ka thugente pom lou in, siam louh tangsak khat anei hi, ka thugen huai thu mahmah in, nitawp ni chiang in amah siam louh atangsak ding hi.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

paite: Keimah phuahtawm in thu ka gen kei a; Pa hon sawlpa'n ka thugen ding leh ka hih ding thu ahon pe zaw hi.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

paite: Amah thupiak tangtawn hinna ahi chih ka thei; huaiziak in ka thugen, Pa hon hilh bang zel in ka gen ahi," achi hi.
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
